dz: 第二次布尔战争:在皮耶特·克龙杰将军所指挥的马格尔斯丰特因战役中,由梅特休恩勋爵所指挥的大英帝国部队在试图解除金伯利围城的围攻下大败.
de: Second Boer War: In the Battle of Magersfontein the Boers commanded by general Piet Cronjé inflict a defeat on the forces of the British Empire commanded by Lord Methuen trying to relieve the Siege of Kimberley.

dz: 美国内战:弗雷德里克斯堡战役从联合将军安布罗斯·伯恩赛德(英语:Ambrose Burnside)所领导的波托马克军队起步,跨越拉帕汉诺克河与联邦将军罗伯特·E·李(英语:Robert E. Lee)率领的北弗吉尼亚军队在弗吉尼亚州弗雷德里克斯堡相冲突.
de: American Civil War: The Battle of Fredericksburg begins as the Army of the Potomac under Union General Ambrose Burnside crosses the Rappahannock River to clash with the Army of Northern Virginia led by Confederate General Robert E. Lee in Fredericksburg, Virginia.

dz: 夏尔·埃马纽埃尔一世(Charles Emmanuel I),萨伏依公爵(Duke of Savoy)和他姐夫西班牙的菲利普三世(Philip 三世)所指挥的部队出击被日内瓦市民所击退. (每年由Fête de l'Escalade评选)

te: The Nyköping Banquet (Swedish: Nyköpings gästabud) takes place as King Birger of Sweden celebrates Christmas at Nyköpin…
dz: 尼克平银行(瑞典语:Nyköpings gästabud)在瑞典国王比尔格在尼克平城堡庆祝圣诞节时举行. 嘉宾中包括他的两个兄弟瓦尔德马尔公爵和埃里克公爵,他们当晚晚些时候被囚禁并被最终饿死在城堡地牢.
de: The Nyköping Banquet (Swedish: Nyköpings gästabud) takes place as King Birger of Sweden celebrates Christmas at Nyköping Castle. Among the guests are his two brothers Duke Valdemar and Duke Eric, who later that night are imprisoned and eventually starved to death in the castle dungeon.

dz: 奥勒温桥之战:威尔士最后一位本土亲王Llywelyn ap Gruffudd被击毙于瓦莱斯中区Builth Wells附近的Cilmeri.
de: Battle of Orewin Bridge: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, is killed at Cilmeri near Builth Wells in mid-Wales.
